# Andorra

[global-law](../) / Andorra

1 repository under this folder (1 legislation, whole country). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 99% | 0% | 0% |

andorra-law holds every law the BOPA publishes under its 'Lleis' theme from 1989 to 2026-10-28 (1,038 texts on main, 3 more on future), and the text matches the BOPA exactly, but each law is held only as first enacted: amendments are not applied, so the Codi penal, Codi de procediment penal, Llei qualificada de la Justícia and labour law read as first passed, and the 2008 Codi de relacions laborals, repealed in 2019, carries no repeal marker. There is no case law, nothing from the 7 comuns, and no law from before 1989.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
